public_interface.validate: validate_requests(reg, requests) -> normalized cells | raises RequestValidationError(.errors=[{index, field, code, message}])

public_interface.diagnostic: daily_block_reconciliation(reg, province_keys, dates) -> DataFrame (independent models, not forced equal)
public_interface.features: build_feature_frame(reg, cells, unit) = training_numeric_representation(build_raw_feature_frame(...)); only this path feeds a bundle
public_interface.training_numeric_contract: the bundles were fitted on numeric features that crossed a CSV text boundary: accepted notebook 10 write_csv_gz wrote them with DataFrame.to_csv(index=False, lineterminator='\n') and pandas DEFAULT float text (no float_format), and accepted notebook 11 load_unit_frame parsed them with pd.read_csv(keep_default_na=False, na_values=['']) and the DEFAULT C float converter (not round_trip), then pd.to_numeric(errors=raise).astype(float). That converter can land 1 ulp away from the in-memory value (seen on doy_sin / doy_cos, |diff| 1.1e-16), and a tree threshold sitting between the two values changes the prediction. Request features therefore pass the same text + parser round trip before prediction: no rounding to a chosen number of decimals, no lookup of stored features, no outcome.
public_interface.errors: RequestValidationError = client error (whole batch rejected); DependencyError = server-side trust / artifact failure (no fallback)
public_interface.how_to_load: exec ONLY the two '# FUNCTIONS' cells of notebooks/13_inference_robustness_contract.ipynb after checking their sha256 equals functions_cells_sha256 here
